description: An existential formula is satisfied exactly when some carrier element satisfies its body in the extended scoped tuple.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.realize_ex.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  {α : Type u'} {l : ℕ} {θ : L.BoundedFormula α l.succ} {v : α → M} {xs : Fin l → M} :
  θ.ex.Realize v xs ↔ ∃ a, θ.Realize v (Fin.snoc xs a)
